title: Weaponmaster prompt not offered when the only Equipment in play is Hand Hammer (ven-027-166)
expected: Reproduced: playing Ornn (sfd-085-221) with Hand Hammer (ven-027-166) in base yields no weaponmaster-equip pick (decision falls straight back to main-phase action), while the identical setup with Serrated Dirk (sfd-009-221) yields the `weaponmaster-equip` pick. Root cause: play-unit.ts:572 gates Weaponmaster options on `registry.get(id)?.cardType === "equipment"`. Serrated Dirk has a hand-authored def (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/serrated-dirk.ts:6 `cardType: "equipment"`), but VEN has no .ts defs — Hand Hammer flows through adaptJsonCard (riftbound-cards/src/data/all-cards.ts:809 `cardType: c.cardType`) which passes ven.json's `"cardType": "gear"` through unchanged, and enrich-cards.ts never remaps gear-with-Equip to equipment. Runtime registry confirms ven-027-166 cardType="gear" (abilities do get re-parsed to Equip [calm], so the `[null]` detail is cosmetic; the cardType is the actual discriminator). Card-data layer bug in Hand Hammer / VEN JSON adaptation, surfaced via Ornn.
observed: No pendingChoice/chain after playing Ornn with Hand Hammer + Seal of Rage in base. Same flow with Serrated Dirk (sfd-009-221) DID prompt. Hand Hammer surfaces as type 'gear' (not 'equipment') and its parsed abilities are [null] in ven.json, so the engine doesn't see it as Equipment. Root cause is Hand Hammer card data, surfaced via Ornn.

history.note: adaptJsonCard: gear with [Equip] adapts to cardType equipment (VEN)

gear-with-[Equip] -> cardType equipment in adaptJsonCard is right but flips 9 tracked BUG tests across 5 files other lanes are mid-edit on; left test.failing repro at __tests__/cards/ven-027-166.test.ts
